coldChainGuarantees.title: Sustainable Harvest at Peak Ocean Season
coldChainGuarantees.subtitle: Certified Fisheries Only
coldChainGuarantees.description: We partner directly with small-boat family fishermen and certified sustainable harvesters in Alaska, Maine, and the Atlantic. Zero industrial aquaculture chemicals, hormones, or preventive antibiotics.

coldChainGuarantees.title: Cryogenic Flash-Freezing at Sea (-40°F)
coldChainGuarantees.subtitle: Locks in Sweetness & Moisture
coldChainGuarantees.description: Our seafood is portioned and blast-frozen within 2 to 4 hours of leaving the icy water. Rapid deep-freezing prevents large ice crystals from forming, preserving natural oceanic cell integrity.

coldChainGuarantees.title: Recyclable Thermal Coolers + Solid Dry Ice
coldChainGuarantees.subtitle: 100% Biodegradable Eco-Liners
coldChainGuarantees.description: Packed in certified curbside-recyclable coolers insulated with non-GMO cornstarch foam and loaded with -109.3°F solid dry ice blocks designed to withstand up to 72 hours of transit.

coldChainGuarantees.title: Guaranteed Arrival Chilled & Frozen (< 4°C)
coldChainGuarantees.subtitle: Zero-Risk 100% Fresh Guarantee
coldChainGuarantees.description: Your catch arrives rock-solid frozen or cold to touch (< 4°C). If your shipment is ever delayed by transit or doesn't arrive in immaculate condition, we replace it or refund 100% immediately.

sourcingOrigins.name: Bristol Bay, Alaska
sourcingOrigins.description: Home to the world's largest certified sustainable wild sockeye salmon run. Clean, glacially fed headwaters ensure unmatched ruby red flesh and natural omega-3 oils.

sourcingOrigins.name: Gulf of Alaska & Dutch Harbor
sourcingOrigins.description: Deep, nutrient-rich trench waters of the North Pacific where halibut and sablefish thrive in cold, high-oxygen depths, developing dense, snow-white meat.

sourcingOrigins.name: Casco Bay & Bar Harbor, Maine
sourcingOrigins.description: Rugged granite coastlines with frigid oceanic currents create the firmest, sweetest lobster meat in the world.

sourcingOrigins.name: Georges Bank, Massachusetts
sourcingOrigins.description: Historic offshore banks bathed in tidal nutrients. Never soaked in sodium tripolyphosphate (STPP) so they sear to a sweet, golden caramel crust.

sourcingOrigins.name: Key West & Gulf of Mexico
sourcingOrigins.description: Wild pink shrimp feed on coral reefs and clean sand bottoms, yielding an unmistakable sweet natural lobster-like snap.

sourcingOrigins.name: Central Pacific & Hawaiian Waters
sourcingOrigins.description: Individual handline-caught ahi, chilled immediately in sea ice brine slurry to preserve pristine gem-like red color and sashimi texture.
